blocks.prompt: 13. If \(\alpha, \beta, \gamma\) are the angles of a triangle \(ABC\), show that \(\cot\dfrac{\alpha}{2} + \cot\dfrac{\beta}{2} + \cot\dfrac{\gamma}{2} = \cot\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\cot\dfrac{\beta}{2}\cot\dfrac{\gamma}{2}\)
blocks.explanation:
Sirf ek maloomat di gayi hai: teeno angles ek triangle ke hain, yani \(\alpha + \beta + \gamma = 180^{\circ}\).
Is ko aadha karein to \(\frac{\alpha}{2} + \frac{\beta}{2} = 90^{\circ} - \frac{\gamma}{2}\) milta hai.
Plan: dono sides ka cot, cot-sum formula (Question 6(i) wala) aur co-ratio, phir terms ki tarteeb.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\alpha + \beta + \gamma = 180^{\circ}\).
Saabit karna hai: \(\cot\frac{\alpha}{2} + \cot\frac{\beta}{2} + \cot\frac{\gamma}{2} = \cot\frac{\alpha}{2}\cot\frac{\beta}{2}\cot\frac{\gamma}{2}\).
Tareeqa:
\[\cot(A + B) = \dfrac{\cot A\cot B - 1}{\cot A + \cot B}\]
(Question 6(i)) aur \(\cot(90^{\circ} - x) = \tan x = \frac{1}{\cot x}\). Triangle wale har sawal mein angles ke jama \(180^{\circ}\) se shuru karna hi pehla qadam hota hai.

Angles ka jama aadha karein
\[\dfrac{\alpha}{2} + \dfrac{\beta}{2} = 90^{\circ} - \dfrac{\gamma}{2}\]
Kyun: Poori equation ko 2 se divide kiya: \(\frac{\alpha}{2} + \frac{\beta}{2} + \frac{\gamma}{2} = 90^{\circ}\), phir \(\frac{\gamma}{2}\) ko doosri taraf le gaye. Half angles is liye chahiye ke sawal mein half angles hi hain.

Dono sides ka cot lein
\[\cot\left(\dfrac{\alpha}{2} + \dfrac{\beta}{2}\right) = \cot\left(90^{\circ} - \dfrac{\gamma}{2}\right)\]
\[= \tan\dfrac{\gamma}{2} = \dfrac{1}{\cot\frac{\gamma}{2}}\]
Kyun: Barabar angles ke cot bhi barabar. \(90^{\circ} - x\) odd multiple of \(90^{\circ}\) hai, is liye cot apne co-ratio tan mein badal jata hai, aur quadrant I mein sign positive rehta hai.

Left side kholein
\[\dfrac{\cot\frac{\alpha}{2}\cot\frac{\beta}{2} - 1}{\cot\frac{\alpha}{2} + \cot\frac{\beta}{2}} = \dfrac{1}{\cot\frac{\gamma}{2}}\]
Kyun: Cot-sum formula mein \(A = \frac{\alpha}{2}\), \(B = \frac{\beta}{2}\) rakha.

Cross-multiply karein
\[\cot\tfrac{\alpha}{2}\cot\tfrac{\beta}{2}\cot\tfrac{\gamma}{2} - \cot\tfrac{\gamma}{2}\]
\[= \cot\tfrac{\alpha}{2} + \cot\tfrac{\beta}{2}\]
Kyun: Left ka numerator right ke denominator \(\cot\frac{\gamma}{2}\) se, aur right ka numerator 1 left ke denominator se multiply hua.
Dhyan dein: \(-1\) ko bhi \(\cot\frac{\gamma}{2}\) se multiply karna hai; yeh term bhoolna aam ghalti hai.

Terms ki tarteeb dein
\[\cot\tfrac{\alpha}{2} + \cot\tfrac{\beta}{2} + \cot\tfrac{\gamma}{2}\]
\[= \cot\tfrac{\alpha}{2}\cot\tfrac{\beta}{2}\cot\tfrac{\gamma}{2}\]
Kyun: Dono sides mein \(\cot\frac{\gamma}{2}\) jama kiya, aur sides ki jagah badal di.

Tasdeeq, equilateral triangle (har angle \(60^{\circ}\))
\[3\cot 30^{\circ} = 3\sqrt{3}\]
\[(\cot 30^{\circ})^3 = (\sqrt{3})^3 = 3\sqrt{3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Half angle \(30^{\circ}\) hai aur \(\cot 30^{\circ} = \sqrt{3}\); dono sides \(3\sqrt{3}\).
